descricao: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions. With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy. We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day. At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients. We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Architect to own the target architecture for a large-scale data platform modernization at a major US mortgage lender — migrating Finance reporting off a legacy on-premises source system onto a governed cloud data platform (Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Snowflake), with CDC-based replication and a certified BI semantic layer. This is deliberately a hands-on role: you build alongside the development team through design and build, not a review-from-a-distance seat. This position calls for a hybrid architect: someone who can design and defend complex technical decisions in front of the client's data and cloud teams at a strategic level, while also working hands-on with the development team to validate and build the solution. A strong grounding in software and data development is essential — profiles limited to analytics work alone will not have the depth this role requires. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end target architecture spanning CDC replication, lakehouse landing (Fabric/OneLake), and a layered cloud data warehouse (raw/staging → conformed → curated) on Snowflake. Author and maintain architecture decision records covering transformation mechanism, CDC/load strategy, semantic-model storage mode, warehouse isolation, and cross-platform (lakehouse-to-warehouse) interoperability. Design the curated data layer and dimensional model, including recomputing source-system runtime-calculated values that don't exist in raw replicated data, and conforming key-value dimension structures into standard reporting attributes. Design the strategy for a single certified BI semantic model consumed by all downstream reporting tools, with metric definitions versioned in one governed place. Work hands-on inside the codebase alongside the development team through the design-and-build core. Lead technical discovery with client architecture, security, and platform teams; resolve open interoperability and network/identity design questions. Own quality gates for architecture decisions — design validation, baseline lock, cutover readiness — and produce the evidence client stakeholders need to sign off. Mentor the development team on transformation patterns, incremental materialization, and reconciliation/data-quality design. Requirements for this challenge Solid experience in data architecture, including hands-on delivery (not review-only) on enterprise data platform modernization programs. Proven experience architecting cloud data platforms on Snowflake, including layered raw/staging/curated models and incremental transformation patterns (e.g., dynamic or materialized tables). Experience with Microsoft Fabric/OneLake, or a comparable lakehouse platform, including cross-platform interoperability between a lakehouse and a cloud data warehouse. Experience architecting change-data-capture (CDC) based replication pipelines (e.g., Qlik Replicate, Fivetran, Debezium, or similar) from a relational source into a cloud platform. Experience designing governed, certified BI semantic layers (Power BI or equivalent) consumed by multiple reporting tools. Strong command of data governance fundamentals: classification, masking, row-level access, lineage. Fluent English (C1) — direct engagement with client architecture, security, and executive stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or another ERP as a source system for financial/GL reporting. Experience in mortgage, lending, or broader financial-services data platforms. Familiarity with AI-assisted development toolchains inside a governed software development lifecycle (SDLC), where AI output is always a draft requiring human sign-off on production logic. Our benefits: -Health and dental insurance -Meal and food allowance -Childcare assistance -Extended paternity leave -Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass; - Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR); -Life insurance - Continuous learning platform (CI&T University); -Discount club -Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being -Pregnancy and responsible parenting course -Partnerships with online learning platforms -Language learning platform And many more! descricao: Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. About BCG Platinion BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale. Practice Area BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design. We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management & financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations. What You'll Do As a BCG Platinion Lead AI Tech Architect, you will help clients turn the potential of AI into scalable, production-ready technology solutions. You will work closely with client technology leaders and BCG teams to understand complex business and technology challenges, define AI and technology strategies, and design architectures that enable meaningful change. You will provide technical direction and architecture leadership across complex AI initiatives, with particular focus on agentic processes and agentic product development lifecycles (PDLC). Drawing on deep architecture expertise and a strong understanding of hands-on implementation, you will guide teams through critical technology decisions and, when needed, provide hands-on support to validate approaches, solve complex technical challenges, or accelerate delivery. Lead the architecture of production-grade AI and agentic solutions, from initial design through implementation. Design agentic architectures incorporating orchestration, tool use, context and memory, guardrails, observability, and human oversight. Advise clients on architecture choices, technology trade-offs, integration patterns, scalability, security, resilience, and operational requirements. Lead complex technology architecture workstreams, translating business needs into clear architecture decisions, roadmaps, and implementation approaches. Guide initiatives involving agentic processes and agentic PDLC, drawing on experience leading comparable technology programs. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, frameworks, and architectural patterns and determine their suitability for specific client contexts. Provide technical direction to multidisciplinary teams while contributing with hands-on expertise when needed to validate designs or resolve complex challenges. Partner with client technology leaders and BCG colleagues to communicate architecture recommendations, build alignment, and support successful implementation. What You'll Bring 10+ years of experience in technology architecture, software engineering, digital delivery, or technology consulting. Proven experience leading and/or designing complex architecture projects involving agentic processes and/or agentic product development lifecycles (PDLC). Deep technical expertise across cloud architecture, distributed systems and microservices, APIs and integration, and modern software engineering – including platform engineering concepts. Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel) and multi-agent design patterns, including tool use, RAG, and context/memory management. Experience designing guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop oversight for agentic systems, along with familiarity with LLM observability and tracing tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, Langfuse). Strong knowledge of production architecture considerations, including security, resilience, observability, scalability, and architecture governance. Expertise with major cloud AI/ML platforms (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry/OpenAI Service, Google Vertex AI), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code. Hands-on technical foundations – including proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Java, TypeScript/Node.js etc.) – that enable you to challenge designs, guide engineering teams, and contribute directly when needed. Ability to navigate complex technology trade-offs and communicate architecture recommendations effectively to senior technical and business audiences. Fluent English; Spanish is a plus. descricao: TGS provides scientific data and intelligence to the global energy sector, enabling energy for all by unlocking vital, data‑driven solutions and knowledge. Through an extensive and diverse energy data library, advanced analytics, cloud‑based applications, and specialized services, we work in a way that is Passionate, Results‑Driven, Collaborative, and Responsible. As the Solutions Architect Lead, you will own the solution and software architecture across research projects within our Rio de Janeiro R&D hub, working as one team with TGS Data Science, TGS software engineering teams and TGS architects in Houston. You will set the architectural direction for products that bridge machine learning and deterministic, physics-based geoscience — ML-driven and conventional processing, imaging and interpretation, the MDIO open-source data format and the TGS Data Verse platform — on GPU and CPU HPC clusters and in the cloud. Your primary objective is to turn research into robust, high-performance products that TGS and its clients rely on, in support of the TGS Strategy. Responsibilities Team Leadership: Lead, mentor and grow a team of scientific software developers, and coordinate architecture with data scientists, geophysicists and TGS software teams across projects, setting clear technical goals, coding standards and development paths. Architecture Governance: Maintain reference architectures and design standards, lead design reviews across research projects together with TGS software architects, and own build-vs-reuse and technical-debt decisions so research projects build on common, reusable components. I work independently, set technical direction and do well in small engineering teams. Evaluate the existing architecture and identify opportunities to scale the platform toward 6x current traffic while maintaining performance and resiliency. Improve caching strategies, including TTLs, refresh patterns, cache placement, performance and downstream dependency management. Help evolve the platform toward active-active resiliency and validate failure, recovery and capacity scenarios. Design and implement automated CI/CD pipelines, including rolling, blue/green or canary deployment strategies, automated checks and quality gates. Establish infrastructure, configuration, secrets and application deployment practices using an everything-as-code approach. Build performance and load-testing capabilities and establish meaningful performance gates for releases. Develop monitoring, alerting and observability for cache latency, throughput, availability, errors and other key reliability indicators. Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and operational KPIs where appropriate. Automate operational tasks and reduce manual intervention through scripting, tooling and infrastructure automation. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis and drive reliability improvements through blameless post-incident reviews. Provide technical guidance and establish engineering guardrails for SRE and development teams. Collaborate with Java/Spring Boot engineers, architects, client FTEs and other technical teams to deliver platform improvements. What We're Looking For Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of experience working in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, platform engineering or a similar production infrastructure role. Apache Cassandra experience, including data modeling, replication, consistency, tuning and multi-datacenter deployments. Experience operating and scaling distributed systems in production environments. Strong understanding of caching architectures, performance optimization and high-availability systems. Hands-on AWS experience and familiarity with cloud-native architecture. Experience designing and implementing automated CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies for highly available systems. Experience with infrastructure/configuration/secrets as code and a strong preference for automated, repeatable processes. Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, alerting, performance metrics and production troubleshooting. Experience with performance testing, capacity planning and identifying system bottlenecks. Strong programming or scripting experience for automation and tooling; Java/Spring Boot experience strongly preferred. Ability to work independently, take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and move work forward with limited direction. Ability to provide technical leadership and establish practical engineering standards and guardrails within a small team. Kubernetes and containerized application experience. GitLab CI/CD experience. Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or similar observability platforms. Kafka, Amazon MSK or other event-streaming technologies. Experience designing active-active or multi-region architectures. Position Summary The Principal Oracle EBS Integration Architect builds and owns the integration layer between Rimini Street's Agentic ERP Platform and Oracle E-Business Suite environments. This role is responsible for designing and building the connectors, data mappings, and transaction flows that enable AI agents to read from and write to Oracle EBS safely and reliably. The broader Oracle integration roadmap includes JD Edwards and Siebel in future phases; this role focuses on EBS as the immediate priority. Reporting to the VP, Platform Engineering, this specialist combines deep Oracle EBS domain knowledge with modern integration engineering skills. The ideal candidate understands EBS architectures, APIs, interface tables, concurrent programs, and data models at a level that allows them to design agent-safe integration patterns—defining which EBS operations become AI-consumable tools, handling transaction boundaries, and enforcing safe-write patterns across complex business processes. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Oracle EBS Integration Architecture Design and own the integration architecture between the Agentic ERP Platform and Oracle E-Business Suite. Define the tool taxonomy for Oracle EBS: determine which APIs, PL/SQL procedures, and interface table operations become agent-consumable tools, and in what shape. Design ISG REST wrapper patterns for EBS, exposing PL/SQL procedures via Integration Service Gateway for agent consumption. Design transaction boundary management: commit/rollback strategies, concurrent request handling, and data consistency guarantees for agent-initiated operations. Enforce the Park/Post pattern: every EBS write tool ships in safe (draft/hold) and full (post/submit) variants, ensuring agents can stage changes for human review before committing. Implement the tiered autonomy progression for EBS tools: Read → Draft → Supervised → Autonomous, controlling which operations agents can execute at each trust level. Connector Development Build and maintain Oracle EBS connectors that translate platform requests into API calls, interface table inserts, or concurrent program submissions. Implement data validation and transformation logic specific to EBS data models and business rules. Design fallback mechanisms for integration path failures, including degraded-mode read-only access and queued write operations. Build connection management for EBS environments: JDBC connection pooling, credential handling, and multi-instance support. Domain Expertise & Guidance Serve as the Oracle EBS subject matter expert for the engineering team, advising on EBS-specific constraints, capabilities, and best practices. Guide MCP Server Developers on EBS-specific tool implementations, schema design, and smart response patterns. Design test strategies for EBS integration: mock environments, data fixtures, and regression suites. Document EBS integration patterns, known limitations, and troubleshooting guides for the engineering team. Provide forward-looking input on JD Edwards and Siebel integration approaches as those phases approach. Cross-functional Collaboration Collaborate with the Integration Lead (SAP) to ensure consistent integration patterns and shared tooling across ERP platforms. Provide input to the Security & Identity Lead on Oracle-specific authentication and authorization requirements. Experience 12+ years of experience working with Oracle E-Business Suite, with deep knowledge of EBS modules, APIs, and data architecture. 5+ years of integration engineering experience: building APIs, connectors, or middleware for enterprise systems. Hands-on experience with EBS integration interfaces: PL/SQL APIs, interface tables, concurrent programs, and Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS). Experience designing integration architectures for complex, multi-module EBS implementations. Awareness of JD Edwards and/or Siebel is valued for future-phase planning. Background in enterprise software support, Oracle consulting, or B2B platforms preferred. Technical Skills Required Oracle E-Business Suite: APIs, interface tables, concurrent programs, and module data models. Oracle PL/SQL for database-level integration and ISG REST wrapper development. Java 21 with Quarkus 3.x for connector and tool server development. RESTful API design and implementation. PostgreSQL for platform-side data operations. OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing across agent-to-tool-to-EBS integration boundaries. Transaction management: commit/rollback strategies, idempotency, and concurrency handling. Git version control and CI/CD practices. Testing: integration test design, mock services, and contract testing. Preferred Experience with Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) or Oracle Integration Cloud. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent-tool interface patterns. Understanding of durable execution patterns (Restate or equivalent) for long-running integration workflows. JD Edwards experience: Business Services, orchestrations, and inclusive/exclusive security modes. Siebel experience: Siebel Object Interfaces, EAI, and web services. Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database. Knowledge of Oracle SOA Suite or Oracle Service Bus. Skills & Competencies Deep Oracle EBS domain knowledge; understands ERP business processes, not just technical interfaces. Integration mindset; designs for reliability, observability, and graceful failure handling. Collaborative; works effectively with platform engineers, agent developers, and SAP integration counterparts. Clear communicator; can translate Oracle-specific constraints into actionable guidance for the broader team. Problem solver; experienced in diagnosing complex integration issues across system boundaries. Self-motivated and effective in a remote environment. Fluent in English (written and verbal). The Maintenance & Automation team plays a critical role in ensuring asset reliability, maintenance excellence, automation performance, and Operational Technology (OT) compliance at the Valinhos manufacturing site. By partnering closely with Production, Engineering, EHS, Quality, and Logistics, the team maximizes equipment availability, drives continuous improvement, and enables safe, efficient operations through innovative technologies. We are looking for an experienced leader who combines technical expertise, strategic thinking, and a passion for innovation. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the site's maintenance, automation, and digital transformation agenda while working closely with local stakeholders and global Maintenance Excellence and Automation teams. The team currently consists of maintenance technicians, a maintenance planner, a maintenance specialist, automation and project resources, students, and external contractors who work collaboratively to ensure operational reliability and business success. The Role & Your Impact This role combines operational, tactical, and strategic responsibilities. You will lead the site's maintenance, reliability, automation, and technology strategy, ensuring high levels of asset availability, operational efficiency, and safe plant operations. As a key member of the site leadership network, you will balance daily operational performance with long-term technology and automation roadmaps, helping to drive reliability improvements, digital transformation, and sustainable business growth. Your key responsibilities in this role Lead the maintenance and reliability strategy for the Valinhos site, ensuring high equipment availability, operational efficiency, and safe plant operations. Act as the primary interface between site operations and the global Maintenance Excellence and Automation teams, driving implementation of standards, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives. Develop and execute the site's automation and technology roadmap, supporting digital transformation and operational performance improvements. Ensure compliance with Operational Technology (OT) requirements, including cybersecurity standards, governance practices, lifecycle management, and risk mitigation. Lead maintenance planning, asset care programs, technical capability development, contractor management, and small capital improvement projects. Support capacity expansion initiatives and capital projects. Lead technical investigations, root cause analyses, and reliability improvement programs. Drive maintenance cost optimization while maintaining safety, compliance, and reliability standards. What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Fluent English communication skills. Significant experience in maintenance, engineering, automation, and manufacturing environments. Proven experience leading technical teams in an industrial setting. Strong knowledge of reliability engineering, preventive and predictive maintenance, maintenance planning, and asset management. Experience with PLCs, SCADA systems, industrial control systems, and manufacturing automation technologies. Understanding of Operational Technology (OT) governance and industrial cybersecurity principles. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration capabilities. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to influence across functions and work effectively within a global matrix organization. Additional Skills & Interests We Value Experience working with global technical organizations. Knowledge of Industry 4.0 initiatives, digital manufacturing, and data-driven maintenance practices. Certifications in TPM, Reliability Engineering, Lean Manufacturing, or Maintenance Excellence. Advanced Spanish language skills. Strong leadership and talent development capabilities. Strategic mindset combined with strong execution and operational discipline. Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for technology, automation, and innovation. High accountability, resilience, and ownership. Our purpose guides the way In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. Opportunities for everyone We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying. We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status. Explore Other Openings If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

You will work on complex, highly visible, and often evolving priorities, quickly structuring ambiguous topics, challenging assumptions, and transforming fragmented information into clear recommendations, decisions, and actions. You will serve as a trusted advisor and execution partner to senior leadership, ensuring strategic priorities maintain momentum and leadership decisions translate into measurable business results. How You’ll Make an Impact Develop and govern integrated project and program plans, aligning critical workstreams, milestones, dependencies, ownership, and priorities required for successful execution. Lead cross-functional coordination by analyzing available information, identifying risks and dependencies, challenging assumptions, and developing actionable recommendations for leadership decision-making. Establish effective program governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication routines to provide leadership with clear visibility into progress, risks, key issues, and required decisions. Partner with internal and external stakeholders across functions to remove barriers, resolve issues, facilitate alignment, and maintain momentum on strategic business priorities. Ensure effective follow-through on leadership decisions by tracking commitments, ownership, timelines, risks, and agreed actions through to closure. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred. Minimum of 10 years of professional experience across business management, project management, consulting, strategy, finance, commercial, operations, or related leadership roles. Proven leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities, with demonstrated ability to influence outcomes in complex, cross-functional environments without direct authority. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous topics, challenge assumptions, synthesize complex information, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing and presenting information and recommendations to senior leadership. Proficiency with project management and business tools, including Microsoft Project and PowerPoint, combined with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with evolving priorities. Professional proficiency in English is required. descricao: Are you passionate about reservoir engineering, technical consulting, and delivering high-impact solutions for complex reservoir challenges? Do you enjoy leading multidisciplinary projects, advising clients, and influencing technical strategies across the energy industry? Join our team! At Baker Hughes, we are transforming the future of energy through advanced technology, engineering expertise, and world-class consulting services. Our GaffneyCline energy advisory team supports clients around the globe by delivering innovative reservoir engineering solutions, strategic insights, and operational excellence that help maximize asset value throughout the energy lifecycle. Partner with the best Our team is committed to providing advanced reservoir engineering expertise and ensuring operational excellence across global projects. This role demands deep technical knowledge, strong leadership, and the ability to mentor and influence across multiple disciplines. As a Senior Principal Reservoir Engineer in Argentina, Brazil or Mexico , you will act as a technical expert for reservoir engineering consulting projects and coordinate communication between clients and the GaffneyCline energy advisory Latin America team. You’ll lead reservoir engineering studies, manage technical work across disciplines, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality reports and presentations. You will also support business development by providing technical and commercial input for proposals and preparing presentations for external clients. As a Senior Principal Reservoir Engineer, you will be responsible for: Providing reservoir engineering input to multi-disciplinary projects, including field development planning, reservoir performance analysis, and reserves estimation and auditing. Conducting reservoir engineering studies using state-of-the-art techniques such as reservoir simulation, material balance, decline curve analysis, well test analysis, and PVT/SCAL data analysis. Advising clients on reservoir engineering matters, reserves and resources evaluation, and reporting methodology. Managing projects, performing peer reviews, and acting as the principal point of contact for clients, ensuring routine follow-up and project delivery. Contributing to business development activities and leading technical input for client proposals. Acting as region focal point for development, implementation, or optimization of deliverables, services, technologies, workflows, or processes. Representing GCea externally through technical publications and participation in industry organizations. Mentoring and developing junior staff members. Ensuring compliance with GCea procedures, business, and quality management systems. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role, you should: Hold a Petroleum Engineering degree with at least 15 years of industry experience, including 7 years with an oil and gas operator. Possess proficiency in discipline-related software such as PETREL, ECLIPSE, T Navigator, and CMG; JewelSuite subsurface modeling skills are a plus. Demonstrate strong knowledge of reservoir engineering topics and the ability to engage clients on discipline applications. Have experience across multiple regional petroleum basins and understand geological settings and reservoir complexities. Demonstrate full professional proficiency in both Spanish and English. Desired Characteristics Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Ability to analyze and resolve problems effectively. Demonstrated ability to lead programs and projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. Working for you Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect: Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities. Comprehensive private medical care options. Safety net of life insurance and disability programs. Tailored financial programs. Additional elected or voluntary benefits. About Us With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient. descricao: About Nu Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role As a Lead Security Engineer you will be a senior technical and risk reference who moves where the risk is, across TPRM, Security Awareness and Cyber Risk, rather than owning a single silo. You will assess security gaps across diverse technologies, third parties and business contexts, quantify what matters, and turn it into prioritized, actionable treatment plans that leadership can decide on. You will build and evolve the policies, methodologies, platforms and automation behind these programs, and help the squad scale across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and other geos without scaling headcount linearly. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Procurement, Operations, Internal Communication, Risk teams and the business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, pragmatic technical specifications. This is a multidisciplinary and global role, working with teams primarily based in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and the United States. You will be responsible for Assess security gaps across business processes and technologies, enable effective risk treatment, and define remediation plans with clear owners and deadlines. Work closely with ITSec, Risk, Procurement stakeholders to align on mitigation of identified risks and on risk acceptance decisions. Lead the evolution of the TPRM program toward a risk-based, lifecycle model: onboarding, continuous monitoring, offboarding, and fourth-party visibility. Define/review security requirements for third parties, including contractual security clauses and annexes, and guide business owners on their application. Build and scale automation and AI-assisted assessment capabilities that reduce manual questionnaire effort and increase coverage. Report third-party risk posture and trends to leadership and relevant committees. Drive human risk programs through phishing simulations, training and communication and evaluate and evolve the tooling behind them (build versus buy). Define and track behavior-change metrics that go beyond completion rates, and report them through dashboards for management. Act as technical lead across the squad, raising the technical and analytical bar and fostering continuous improvement. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Proven experience designing and implementing security controls and leading risk management initiatives, with strong knowledge of domains and concepts of cyber risks. Hands-on experience with risk analysis techniques: risk identification, assessment and prioritization, using both qualitative and quantitative methods. Experience with TPRM (third-party risk management). Experience building or running security awareness and human-risk programs, or a strong ability to ramp up on them quickly. Experience with large-scale distributed environments and cloud environments (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure). Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-30, ISO 27001/27002/27005, ISO 31000, PCI-DSS, ITIL, COBIT and similar. Excellent executive communication skills, able to translate complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees. Technical background and comfort with automation, scripting and AI or LLM-based tooling to scale security processes. Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators. Proven ability to lead projects and process improvement initiatives, and to mentor other engineers and analysts. Advanced English proficiency, written and spoken. Spanish is a plus. Nice to have Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Information Security, Risk Management or related fields. Certifications such as PCI ISA or PCIP, CISA, CISM or CISSP. Experience in a regulated fintech, financial services environment or consulting roles. Experience with AI risk: assessing risks of generative AI and LLM use cases (data leakage, prompt injection, model and vendor risk) Location for this opportunity (City, Country) São Paulo, Brazil Campinas, Brazil Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Belo Horizonte, Brazil Benefits Chance of earning equity at Nubank Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação) Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan Dental Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses Extended Parental Leave Daycare Allowance Parental Consultancy Work-from-home Allowance Gym Partnerships 30 days of paid vacation Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/ Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. descricao: About FullStack FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. We’re Most Proud Of Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies. Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor. Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. The Position Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment. This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer . You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday. On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines. We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up. How We Approach The Work FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment: Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec. Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology. Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why. Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value. Consultative Discovery Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch. Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two. Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success. Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better. Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology. What You'll Do Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view. Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components. Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments. Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go). 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos. Advanced English is required. Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex. Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps. Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling. Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes. Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output. Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP. Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems. Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision. Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. Forensic attention to detail. A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. Strong Plus Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems. Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases. Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing). Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense. Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background. Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system. Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts. Work Authorization Requirements Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis. FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future. What We Offer Competitive pay. 100% remote work. The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies. Continuing education opportunities. Opportunity to grow and expand your career. Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration. Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

descricao: Purpose & Scope As the Data Science Lead (coordinator), you will lead a team of data scientists and scientific software developers within our Rio de Janeiro R&D hub, working as one team with TGS Data Science in Houston. You will set the technical direction for developing, scaling and supporting TGS’s AI and data technologies: ML-driven processing and interpretation, the MDIO open-source data format and the TGS Data Verse platform — on GPU and CPU HPC clusters and in the cloud. Your primary objective is to turn research into robust, high-performance software that TGS and its clients rely on, in support of the TGS Data-AI strategy (AI for Growth). Responsibilities Team Leadership: Lead, mentor and grow a team of data scientists and scientific software developers, setting clear technical goals, coding standards and development paths. Technical Direction: Define the architecture of ML models, data pipelines and HPC/cloud workflows in line with the TGS Data Science roadmap in Houston — one shared codebase and toolset. AI Development: Oversee the design, scaling and validation of deep learning models for seismic processing, imaging and interpretation, from seismic foundation models (ViT) to 3D CNNs such as SaltNet. Performance & Scalability: Drive the profiling, parallelization and optimization of training and inference on GPU and CPU clusters (CUDA, MPI, multi-node) and on AWS, keeping compute efficient and costs under control. Data Platforms: Champion MDIO and cloud-native data practices — chunked, compressed data accessible in place — and integration with TGS Data Verse (Data Lake, OSDU) and Prediktor operational data. Production Readiness: Own the path from prototype to product — packaging, testing, CI/CD, model registry and deployment into TGS production software (e.g., Imaging AnyWare) and HPC environments. Engineering Excellence: Establish best practices across research and production code: clean architecture, code review, automated testing, documentation and reproducible experiments. User & Business Support: Partner with geophysicists, imaging, HPC/IT and product teams to turn needs into requirements and to support users of TGS AI and data tools across the energy data value chain. Innovation & Representation: Track advances in AI, HPC and data technology; drive open-source contributions (e.g., MDIO), patents and publications; represent TGS in technical forums. Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Geophysics, Physics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related field, including 5+ years leading R&D or software projects. Leadership Experience: 3+ years leading data science, research or scientific software teams, with a track record of delivering software to production. Technical Experience: Expert Python (NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch) and modern C/C++; Fortran is a plus. Highly experienced with MPI, CUDA, OpenMP or other parallel programming models on GPU and CPU HPC architectures. Highly experienced in debugging, profiling and optimizing scientific code (e.g., Nsight, perf, VTune). Distributed training and inference of deep learning models (DDP/FSDP, mixed precision) and MLOps practices (experiment tracking, model registry, deployment). UNIX/Linux and POSIX programming, Git, automated testing and CI/CD. Data & Infrastructure: Multidimensional, chunked data formats (MDIO, Zarr, SEG‑Y) with Dask/xarray; AWS (S3, EC2 GPU); containers (Docker, Kubernetes); HPC schedulers (e.g., Slurm). Domain Expertise: Experience with seismic processing, imaging or interpretation algorithms; publications or patents in ML, HPC or geophysics are a strong advantage. Desirable: OSDU data platforms and master data management; industrial time-series data and OPC UA; contributions to open-source scientific software (e.g., MDIO). Languages: Fluent English and Portuguese Work arrangement & Location: Presential, based in Rio de Janeiro – RJ, with Brazilian residency and work authorization, and available for occasional travel.

PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES What do you think about joining an innovative, engaged, and collaborative development environment, building a cutting-edge platform for big data with a team of experts worldwide? The Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS) enables SAP Lines of Business and customers to easily enter the world of Big Data and enable customers to integrate SAP data with external partner data engineering tools and non-SAP data. We are looking for a Developer / Platform Engineer with strong backend development skills and working knowledge of cloud-native application development. The role is suitable for an experienced engineer who can contribute independently to development, troubleshooting, quality, and delivery of platform services. This is not a data scientist role. The team builds and operates platform services that enable scalable, secure, and reliable data storage and access. THE PRODUCT The major goal of BDFS is to enable SAP Lines of Business (LoB’s) and customers to enter the world of big data easily. To achieve that objective, we’re delivering Apache Spark as a service, a multi-language engine for executing data engineering, data science, and machine learning on single-node machines or clusters (Kubernetes in our case). We’re enabling data to be consumed from multiple hyperscaler agnostic data sources using the Delta Sharing communication protocol on top of the HANA Data Lake File Service (HDLFS), an SAP-managed cloud object storage that allows storage and consumption of data without multiple layers of ETL (Extract Transform and Load) systems and intermediary data storages (Lakehouse architecture). What You’ll Do As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for architecture, design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, and quality assurance activities in a development team. In Your Day-to-day Work, Your Tasks Will Include Drive architecture and technical design discussions. Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable cloud-native backend services. Own complex technical topics from analysis and design to implementation and delivery. Contribute to platform architecture decisions around service lifecycle, provisioning, credentials, configuration, resiliency, observability, and operational readiness. Develop backend services and platform components using Java and related technologies. Work on distributed applications and services running in cloud/container environments. Evaluate technical options, identify trade-offs, and recommend practical architecture solutions. Contribute to secure-by-design architecture and platform engineering practices. Ensure platform services follow security, reliability, scalability, and operational best practices. Contribute to architecture discussions around authentication, authorization, secrets management, encryption, and secure multi-tenant design. Support observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational readiness practices for platform services. Build PoCs and validate technical approaches for complex platform topics. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production and development issues. Review code, design documents, and implementation approaches to ensure high engineering quality. Mentor and guide junior developers and help improve technical maturity within the team. Support Product team and Architects in technical discussions and planning. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across locations. Work in an agile team that uses the Scrum framework to self-organize and work towards development goals. Contribute to engineering practices around clean code, CI/CD, testing, automation, security, observability, and operational excellence. What You Bring Required Skills Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or related technical fields. Advanced or fluent English. Strong hands-on experience in backend/platform engineering. Excellent programming skills, preferably with Java and/or Go. Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, space complexity, and run-time complexity. Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean code, and software architecture principles. Experience designing and building cloud-native distributed systems. Experience with Kubernetes, containerized applications, and cloud deployment models. Experience with at least one hyperscaler or cloud ecosystem such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Strong understanding of REST APIs, service integrations, distributed application design, and failure handling. Ability to define and evaluate architecture trade-offs around scalability, availability, reliability, maintainability, security, and cost. Ability to troubleshoot complex software and platform issues using technical and product knowledge. Experience with CI/CD, code review, test-driven development, and modern software delivery practices. Knowledge of software quality assurance and test methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, and automation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to mentor developers and support technical decision-making. Ability to quickly learn new areas of knowledge and drive topics independently. High level of ownership, commitment, team spirit, flexibility, and initiative. NICE TO HAVE Experience with cloud object storage services such as AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, or Google Cloud Storage. Exposure to Object Store, service broker patterns, provisioning flows, credential handling, or service lifecycle management. Experience with infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform, Helm, or similar. Experience with Linux, scripting, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering. Experience with observability topics such as logging, metrics, tracing, monitoring, alerting, and incident analysis. Experience with secure multi-tenant cloud services. Experience with performance optimization, reliability engineering, or cost optimization. Exposure to Apache Spark, Delta Sharing, Lakehouse architecture, or big data platform services. Experience working with globally distributed agile/Scrum development teams. Experience in technical mentoring, architecture reviews, design reviews, or technical leadership. LEARNING OPPORTUNITIES You will work on architecture and engineering topics for enterprise-grade cloud platform services. You will work on cloud-native backend services, distributed systems, and secure multi-tenant platform capabilities. You will influence architecture decisions around scalability, reliability, observability, automation, and operational readiness. You will collaborate with experienced developers, architects, product owners, and platform teams across locations. You will help shape engineering practices and mentor developers in backend and platform engineering topics. The Big Data Fabric Services team is responsible for: Extend and complete the SAP Data Platform with big data technologies and third-party partnerships to support different SAP Lines of Business and SAP customers to enter the world of Big Data. Leverage Apache Spark and Object store technology to provide scalable and cost-effective computing and storage services for big data ingestion, processing, and sharing. Integrate into SAP BTP and HANA Cloud to offer unified development and deployment experience for different SAP Lines of Business. Assure multi-tenancy and secure data processing. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to operate and improve a Snowflake-based enterprise data platform in a regulated healthcare environment. MUST HAVES - 5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering or Data Platform Engineering. - Strong hands-on experience operating and developing solutions on Snowflake , including data-layer design, warehouse performance, access patterns, and production troubleshooting. - Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with dbt for transformation, testing, documentation, lineage, and controlled deployment. - Experience operating managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran or HVR and supporting custom data-ingestion pipelines. - Hands-on experience with AWS data services , particularly S3 and event-driven or file-based ingestion patterns. - Experience orchestrating and troubleshooting data workloads with Argo Workflows on Kubernetes , or comparable workflow-orchestration technologies. - Proficiency in Python or a comparable language for data engineering, automation, and operational tooling. - Strong understanding of data modeling, pipeline dependencies, schema evolution, backfills, data validation, and production data quality. - Experience with observability, logging, alerting, and incident-management practices for production data platforms. - Demonstrated ability to lead complex incident resolution, perform root-cause analysis, and convert findings into preventive improvements. - Ability to make well-reasoned technical decisions, identify tradeoffs, estimate work, and guide improvements across a complex platform. - Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively with Cloud / DevOps, Analytics, Security, Governance, and business stakeholders. - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work directly with client stakeholders. - Full availability to work from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time and participate in an agreed on-call rotation. NICE TO HAVES - Hands-on experience with a data-specific observability platform. - Experience supporting Tableau Cloud administration, data-source connectivity, extracts, scheduled refreshes, or production dashboard dependencies. - Familiarity with Snowflake cost optimization, audit logging, tasks, stored procedures, and environment rationalization. - Experience migrating legacy ingestion or orchestration patterns such as Boomi or AWS Data Pipeline to modern managed or Kubernetes-based solutions. - Experience with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code practices supporting data platforms. - Experience with service-management and change-control tools such as Freshservice and Jira. - Familiarity with HIPAA, GDPR, FDA-related controls, least-privilege access, separation of duties, and audit-ready operational practices. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Provide senior technical ownership for the Data Platform service tower during the LatAm coverage window, including day-to-day operations, complex troubleshooting, and L2/L3 escalation. - Operate and improve Snowflake production and non-production environments, including warehouse configuration and sizing, performance and consumption monitoring, object lifecycle, environment hygiene, and support for production changes. - Administer data access within established controls, including users, roles, service accounts, secrets, and credential rotation, while maintaining least-privilege and audit-ready practices. - Operate and improve data ingestion across Fivetran, HVR where applicable, and custom pipelines, including connector configuration, scheduling, source onboarding, schema-change coordination, failure recovery, backfills, and dependency management. - Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and dbt models across RAW, CURATED, and CONSUMPTION layers, with appropriate testing, documentation, lineage, version control, and CI/CD practices. - Support AWS S3 data-lake operations, including raw and landing-zone workflows, lifecycle and retention controls, access patterns, logging, ingestion failures, and coordination with downstream Snowflake workloads. - Support Argo Workflows and Kubernetes-hosted data workloads in close coordination with the Cloud / DevOps team, including scheduling, troubleshooting, deployment, recovery, and capacity dependencies. - Define and improve data quality and observability standards, including freshness, zero-row, row-count growth, null, duplicate, schema-drift, and referential-integrity checks. - Expand end-to-end monitoring and lineage using tools such as SYNQ, dbt, Snowflake audit data, Splunk, and the agreed alerting stack, linking actionable alerts to evidence and runbooks. - Lead or support major data incidents, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and preventive actions across ingestion, orchestration, Snowflake, and downstream Tableau dependencies. - Support Tableau Cloud operations where upstream data, connectivity, permissions, extracts, or refresh failures require Data Platform investigation. - Identify and deliver standardization, automation, reliability, performance, and cost improvements, including migration of suitable legacy or custom extraction patterns toward agreed golden paths. - Execute work through controlled incident, request, access, change, and release processes using established service-management workflows. - Create and maintain runbooks, operating procedures, architecture context, ownership information, recovery procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials. - Mentor Middle-level engineers, review technical work, improve team practices, and ensure effective handoffs across the distributed service team. - Participate in the Data Platform on-call rotation for critical incidents outside staffed service hours. descricao: Why Cast AI? Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production. The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation. Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS. Global team, diverse perspectives We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead. Unicorn momentum In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started. Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure. This is a location-specific opportunity. We are currently accepting applications from candidates residing in the following countries: Bulgaria, Croatia, Estonia, Greece, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Cyprus, Malta, Finland, Sweden, Ireland, Moldova, North Macedonia, Montenegro and Ukraine. What you'll be solving Every dollar Cast AI saves a customer has to be provable, every action taken on their infrastructure has to be attributable to someone authorized to take it, and every price used to make that case has to be current across every cloud, region, and availability zone. This is the trust and accounting layer underneath the whole platform: get it wrong, and customers can't log in, can't trust the savings number, or get billed incorrectly - any one of which ends the relationship. This posting covers multiple teams working on different pieces of the same trust-and-accounting problem: authentication, authorization, and SSO for every user and workload. Billing, audit trails, notifications, and feature flags that keep the platform transparent for every customer. Real-time cloud pricing tracking across every region and availability zone, including Spot availability and discounts. And reporting that turns high-volume time-series data into fast, accurate answers about what the automation actually saved. Requirements Strong software engineering fundamentals: you design clean abstractions, write maintainable code, and can justify your architecture choices - not just make something work. Production experience with Go is strongly preferred; candidates without Go should demonstrate strong systems programming skills in a comparable language. You've built or operated trust-critical systems at scale - authentication/authorization, billing, or financial/accounting-adjacent data, where being wrong has real consequences. Good understanding of API design best practices - versioning, backward compatibility, auth, idempotency, async patterns, and similar. Strong debugging, optimization, and performance-tuning skills – including query profiling, index design, and database performance tuning beyond ORM usage. Experience operating and optimizing systems under high load - you know how to find and fix the bottleneck, not just add more resources. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes - you understand the core concepts (pods, services, deployments) and have deployed or debugged something on a cluster. Experience with AI coding agents and agentic development workflows. You've personally driven a complex project end-to-end. Strong English skills, both verbal and written. Startup mindset: adaptable, proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity. Participate in on-call rotation for teams that require it. Nice to haves Multi-tenant identity system design - authentication, authorization, SSO. Enterprise identity protocols - SAML, OIDC, and SCIM for enterprise account provisioning and sync. Billing, audit-trail, notification, or feature-flag systems in production. Experience with cloud provider pricing/billing APIs across AWS, GCP, or Azure, or tracking Spot instance availability. High-cardinality time-series ingestion and querying at scale. Understanding of Kubernetes internals. CI/CD and DevOps practices experience. Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) in production. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate backend services in Go that other teams and customers depend on being correct. Own features end-to-end: from design through implementation, testing, and production rollout. Debug complex production issues involving security-, money-, or trust-critical flows. descricao: About FullStack FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. We’re Most Proud Of Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies. Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor. Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. The Position Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment. This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer . You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday. On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines. We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up. How We Approach The Work FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment: Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec. Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology. Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why. Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value. Consultative Discovery Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch. Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two. Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success. Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better. Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology. What You'll Do Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view. Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components. Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments. Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go). 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos. Advanced English is required. Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex. Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps. Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling. Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes. Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output. Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP. Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems. Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision. Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. Forensic attention to detail. A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. Strong Plus Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems. Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases. Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing). Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense. Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background. Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system. Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts. Work Authorization Requirements Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis. FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future. What We Offer Competitive pay. 100% remote work. The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies. Continuing education opportunities. Opportunity to grow and expand your career. Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration. Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.
